title: A customer and a vendor stored with a blank term count under COD
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A and vendor A were stored with a blank credit term before the release.
  • Before you start, write down COD's Customers count (number A) and Vendors count (number B), with them included.
  • Make sure the organization's Counter Sale customer is on COD.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the COD row.
  2. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
  3. Choose "Net 30" in Credit Terms.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Reload the Credit Terms page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customers reads number A and Vendors reads number B.

Step 2:

  • The window opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 30.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the customer is saved on Net 30.

Step 5:

  • COD reads number A − 1 (for example 121 − 1 = 120).
  • The Counter Sale customer was never in the count.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
  • S1-R13: “The Vendors column shows how many vendors hold the term, right aligned, 0 when none, by the same rules as S1-R12 (a blank vendor term counts under COD).”
  • S11-R9: “Customers and vendors with a blank term are counted under COD on the Credit Terms page; their records are not changed.”
  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”
  • Terminology: “Counter Sale customer → The organization's built-in walk-in customer that over-the-counter sales are invoiced to; there is exactly one per organization, created with the organization. It always stays on COD and is never counted, listed or moved on the Credit Terms page.”
